== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-09-bloodline|The Purelake is a large, [[sapphire]]-colored body of [[water]] located south of a pyramid within the [[Desolate Wilds]]. It stands in stark contrast to the surrounding landscape, which is characterized by dark, tainted waters and corruption. The lake serves as a vital source of drinkable [[water]] in a region where such resources are otherwise scarce for many miles. It is also known to nourish much of the wilds and has been subject to intense tremors, such as when waves grew large enough to threaten fishing vessels. Historically, the area has seen rapid development; for instance, a temple outpost and its associated structures were constructed by [[sacred artists]] in a very short period. The lake is also associated with specialized remnants that possess the primary aspect of [[water]], allowing for techniques that can manifest [[water]] from atmospheric [[aura]].}}
